faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking.

items.q: How long does a nail appointment take?
items.a: Most services take between 45 minutes to 1.5 hours depending on the complexity. Gel extensions and intricate nail art may take up to 2 hours. We'll always give you a time estimate when you book.

items.q: Do I need to pay a deposit when booking?
items.a: No! We never charge deposits or hidden fees. You only pay when you arrive at your appointment. Easy and stress-free.

items.q: Can I reschedule or cancel my booking?
items.a: Absolutely. You can reschedule or cancel anytime through your account dashboard or by messaging us on WhatsApp. We just ask for at least 4 hours notice.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept cash, Visa, MasterCard, and mobile wallets (Vodafone Cash, InstaPay). Pay however is most convenient for you.

items.q: How does the loyalty points program work?
items.a: You earn points with every booking. Once you hit the threshold, you automatically receive a discount coupon for your next visit. Create a free account to start earning!

items.q: Do you use gel or acrylic products?
items.a: We use premium, salon-grade gel and acrylic products from trusted international brands. All our products are safe, long-lasting, and gentle on natural nails.
